_comment: Single source of truth for the shared chrome. partials/header.html and
partials/footer.html own the markup; this file declares the only values that
differ per page. Run `node scripts/sync-chrome.cjs` after editing either.
These partials map to Shopify Liquid snippets (header.liquid / footer.liquid)
with these slots becoming snippet parameters.
base  — prefix for section anchors that may live on another page.
asset — prefix for files under assets/.
Every slot below is a real, reviewed difference. Anything not listed here is
identical on every page by construction; tests/shared-chrome.test.cjs fails
if a page drifts from the partial.
